part5_patel_thm2_randomised_offset.note: Patel et al. Thm 2 is explicit but average-case over the phase. Applying a uniformly random known phase offset to the register (no oracle calls) makes the success probability at every phase equal to the average, so Thm 2 becomes an explicit worst-case guarantee; its constant is ~1e5 above the window value. Argument here (modelled), not stated in the source.

part6_lanes_W1e7.note: WS-k k_lat (18 / 2 lanes) uses source widths with source depth; the decision table's k_10x uses the floor depth at W=1e7, where the primary design is 5.28M / 10M wide.
